title: Evaluating an Intervention for Physician Burnout
official: Evaluating an Evidence-Based Intervention for Physician Burnout
summary: The goals of this randomized controlled trial are 1) to test the efficacy of an app-based program in reducing physician burnout vs. no app (control) in 100 physicians; 2) to explore the role of an online live training to augment outcomes and develop an ongoing and sustainable support community with a subsample of physicians.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Being a physician
2. Able to speak English because all study activities will be conducted in English.
3. 18+ years
4. Direct patient care

Exclusion Criteria:

1\. If using psychotropic medication - not on a stable dosage at least 6 weeks
